method_selection: R11 and nominal are co-references fixed by user; do not select a winner after C01
development_data: H01-H04; no claim that those remain blind
operating_point: F01; no claim of untested operating-point generalization
rx_out_support: Independent signed branch factors magnitude 1%-3%, R and X paired, fixed before t0, physically consistent equilibrium
noise_policy: R5C.2 frozen stream; seed shared across paired conditions and scales; never copy RAW residuals

persistent_line.sources: All nine frozen line assets; exclude islanding alternatives before execution

independence_unit: Physical parent; group all conditions and noise realizations when bootstrapping. PMU samples and replays are not independent trials
primary_continuous: paired differences against both frozen ExtraTrees models
primary_persistent: first stopping decision after true ON
normal false alarms and monitored exposure
secondary: BUS31 with all other source strata
chen_contract: One stopping decision at 15 nonoverlapping increments/s, 300-report prefix, beta=3600s, no restart or OFF operator. Score only persistent-line/normal lane; mixed lane may be descriptive out-of-contract stress
threshold_policy: All existing thresholds, priors, signatures, fixed bias rule, likelihoods and both ML artifacts unchanged. No threshold selection on C01
comparison_policy: Methods receive same raw 30fps stream; native Chen computes 15fps increments. Score native emission times without retroactive interpolation or oracle resets
failure_policy: No successful-only denominator. Solver rejects and inference failures retained separately and included as incomplete intended cases; no replacement draws
uncertainty_policy: Parent-cluster paired bootstrap, percentile 95% intervals. Finite-sample intervals descriptive. For zero normal alarms provide exposure and one-sided Poisson upper bound with model caveat
publication_rule: No mandatory perfect accuracy. Report all superiority failures and negative ablations; no claim that historical hackathon leaderboard score improved
source_scope: Known 9-load/9-line model catalog, not unseen-source validation, not all 39 buses
